description: Mapping of insider-threat behavior patterns to MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs. Hardcoded from public ATT&CK documentation (enterprise matrix) — no live API call needed. Each entry maps a pattern name to its tactic, technique ID, technique name, and the log fields / heuristics that trigger it on CERT data.

patterns.trigger: A user opens/copies a file they have no prior access history for (file.csv rows for a user not seen on that filename in earlier events)
device.csv row with activity=Connect, especially when followed by file.csv writes to removable-media paths or large attachment content
email.csv row with attachments>0 sent to a recipient whose domain is outside the organization's internal domain list (e.g., yahoo/gmail/external domains)

patterns.tactic: Initial Access / Persistence / Privilege Escalation / Defense Evasion
patterns.trigger: logon.csv Logon rows between 22:00-05:00 local time, or on weekends, deviating from the user's established workday window
email.csv rows with size > 1 MB threshold, or http.csv URLs matching known upload/file-sharing endpoints, or http.csv volume bursts for one user
email.csv rows whose to/cc/bcc lists contain >=3 external-domain addresses
file.csv rows whose filename matches sensitive-data keywords (e.g., confidential, financial, payroll, classified, report) and are accessed outside normal role-based usage
http.csv rows targeting known cloud-storage/upload endpoints (e.g., file-sharing services) or URLs with high-entropy path names indicative of encoded uploads
